text.t: NPC {0} is a great priestess of the {1}. She has received intel which suggests that the {2}, an ancient record detailing Muren Reksmilon's battle against Sekneum, has been located amongst Kundun's minions. Anyone which reads the {2}, can obtain knowledge which will increase their abilities. Agree to find the item for {0} and she will allow you gain its ability first.
[Part 1] FIND THE SCROLL OF THE EMPEROR
Have you heard of Muren Reksmilon, who became the first emperor of MU after he defeated Sekneum and unified the continent? There are rumors that the {0}, where this story is recorded, has been found.
The {0} contains a record of the treasures left by the three heroes of the Divine War, including Muren himself. The God of Light, Rugard, has given you the mission to find the {0}.
You must offer 1 million Zen to Rugard if you want to receive this mission. Would you like to accept the mission and find the {0}?
According to the rumors, the {0} can be found in the Dungeon, Lost Tower or Atlans.
{0} should contain information about the treasures that the three heroes of the Divine War have left behind.

{0} contains historical records of the first emperor of the continent, Muren, as well as what happened during the Peace Festival commemorating the victory in the war and the unification of the continent.
Muren Reksmilon unified the three Muren ended the Divine War with Arca's Great Mage Etramu Renos and Noria's Elf Queen Lunedill Diochell, and was revered as a hero.
After the empire was established and peace achieved, everyone in the continent swore their loyalty to the emperor, and they offered treasures as a token.
The {0}, the {1}, and the {2}. The {0} was offered by the Dark Knights of Lorencia as a symbol of their bravery and loyalty; whising for the empire's prosperity.
The {0} was offered by the Elf Queen Lunedill Diochell as a token of her vow to strengthened the unity between elves and humans.
The {0} was offered by Great Mage Etramu as a symbol of his bow to dedicate his power for the peace and freedom of the empire.
From the records of the Peace Festival held in the 10th year.
Where to find the Scroll of the emperor?
What monsters drops the Scroll of the emperor?
Dungeon: Poison Bull fighter, Dark Knight, Gorgon.
Lost Tower: Shadow, Poison Shadow, Cursed Wizard, Death Cow, Devil.
You have read the Scroll of the Emperor. So now you know what the three treasures left by the heroes are?
Go find the {0} or {1}. Rumors say that if may be found around Atlans, Lost Tower or Tarkan.
I know you are strong, but always be careful, because this task can be dangerous. Once you find the {0} or {1}, please bring it back to me.
Now that you have found the {0} and proven your strong will, you will called a Blade Knight.
Now that you have found the {0}, that symbolizes the strong mind, you'll be called a Soul Master.
Now that you have found the {0}, which symbolizes the pure heart, you'll be called a Muse Elf.
I respect your courage and i shall grant you a new power. May the blessing of Rugard, the God of Light, be with you...

You have read the Scroll of the Emperor. Do you know about the secret agreement between Muren and Semeden, the leader of the Summoners? In return for not annexing Elbe into the empire, Semeden promised one thing to Muren.
He promised that as long as MU existed, the Summoners would guard the Dimensional Gate. As a symbol of this promise, Semeden gave the {0}. Please find the {0}, which is the proof of that promise.
I heard that the {0} may be found around Atlans, Lost Tower or Tarkan. Once you find the {0}, please bring it back to me.
You, who has brought the {0}. In the name of Dimensional Watcher Semeden, I give you the title of Blood Summoner.
I respect your courage and i shall grant you a new power. May the blessing of Rugard, the God of Light, be with you...
The {0} is said to have originated from Muren's sword, the {1}, which Muren himself broke after he unified the continent, in the hopes that war would never happen again.
The Dark Knights of Lorencia also broke their swords and offered them to Muren, swearing that they would only use their swords when absolutely needed.
Muren was greatly pleased and gave them the title of {0}. Since then, Dark Knights seeking to become Blade Knights break their swords to demonstrate their will.
The {0} is the crystallized tear of an elf, dropped during the coming of age ceremony. The one offered to Muren was the Tear of Elf Queen, Lunedill Diochell.
The {0} is a magic stone that symbolizes the strong mind of a Dark Wizard, and it is said that Etramu offered it to Muren as a symbol of his vow.
The {0} is a material that cannot be found in this world, created from the transformation of materials during dimensional transfer. It contains the memories of the era.
To those who watch over the dimensions, the {0} is an important symbol.
Where to find the Broken Sword, Tear of Elf, Soul Shard of Wizard or Abyssal Eye?
What monsters drops the Broken Sword, Tear of Elf, Soul Shard of Wizard or Abyssal Eye?
Lost Tower: Death Knight, Death Gorgon, Balrog.
Atlans: Great Bahamut, Silver Valkyrie, Lizard King, Hydra.

During party hunting, if there is a party member who has been given a quest, the quest item will be dropped from the monster. However, item acquisition is only possible for the character who is performing the quest.
If you have a quest item in your inventory, the item will no longer drop when hunting.
Dropped quest items disappear after 1 minute.
Acquired quest items cannot be stored in the warehouse.
Acquired quest items cannot be sold in the shop.
Acquired quest items cannot be traded.
Secondary quest items can only be acquired for each class.

NPC {0} is a loyal guard who works for the {1}, assisting as a guard in various cities. He has received intel which suggests rumors of the {2}, a sacred item lost during Giaon's revolt, being located near Tarkan. Anyone which equips the {3} can be blessed with its magical additional abilities and strength. The ring was created at the time which the {4} was created, with the exact same indestructible metallic materials. The ring was then blessed by Etramu to prevent evil from manipulating its power. Agree to find the item for {0} and he will show you how to gain its ability first.
I have something to ask of you. Would you lend me your ear?
I would like to ask you to find the {0} for me. The {0} is the greatest relic of all; given by the God of Light, Rugard, to the heroes who were victorious in the war against Sekneum.
If we don't find the {0}, something bad may happen to the continent. You can work on this if you have 3 million zen. Would you like to try?
From the information I've gathered, the {0} seems to be closer than I thought. It might be around Atlans, Tarkan or Icarus.
You have found the {0}! I knew you could do it!

I told you this already, but the {0} was given by the God of Light, Rugard, to the heroes of the Divine War. Other than the three heroes we already know, there was also Kundun Mephis - the Great Mage of Arca, and Gaion Kalein - The Vice.
But as you know, Great Mage Kundun Mephis and Vice Commander Gaion Kalein were stained with darkness, and their {0} were lost.
The {0} contains the sacred power of Rugard, so if Kundun used it with evil intentions, it would be definitely catastrophic. That's why the empire's guards have been trying so hard to find the {0}.
We are very relieved and and grateful to you for bringing back the {0}. I've already submitted a report regarding your performance to the {1}, who serve Rugard.
As a token of gratitude, I would like to tell you useful information, since you have trained so hard as a Blade Knight...

There's this fighting method that is passed on secretly within the empire's army. It's only taught to people who have trained for a long time as a Blade Knight. If you are interested, I can teach it to you.

The Ring of Honor is a sacred item which was created during the time the Secromicon was created. The two sacred items were created with identical indestructible materials, in which created the most sacred pieces of history to ever exist. The ring was created with great magical power, which was told to bring everlasting youth to its possessor. Some tales even say it has the ability to bring the dead back to life. Because of its great possible strength, Etramu casted a magical spell on it, ridding evil from manipulating its potential power. However, Kundun's invasion inevitably became this item's history, as it was lost during Giaon's revolt. Retrieving the sacred item would be a great step to recovering the empire's lost faith.
Where to find the Ring of Honor?
What monsters drops the Ring of Honor?
Aida: Death Tree, Forest Orc, Death Rider, Blue Golem, Witch Queen, Hellmaine.
Exclusive quest for Blade Knights and Grow Lancers

There's this fighting method called {0}, that is passed on secretly within the empire's army. It's only taught to people who have trained for a long time as a Blade Knight. If you are interested, I can teach it to you.
There's this fighting method called {0}, that is passed on secretly to Temple Knight Royal Guards. It's a technique that only Grow lancers can learn. If you are interested, I can teach it to you.
Alright. But in order to learn Combo/Circle Shield, we need a special magic stone called the {0}. You have to use the magic stone to change the energy that flows within your body.
I heard that the {0} can be found in Tarkan or Icarus. You can work on this if you have 2 million Zen. Would you like to try?
Since You found the {0}, I have no doubt you'll be able to find the {1}. Please come back to me once you find the {1}.
You really found the {0}! Now, I will change the flow of the energy within your body.
Well, that's done. Now I'll tell you more about Combos. Combo is a method that allows you to wield explosive power at once by coordinating various skills in a set pattern.
As for the order of the skills, you must activate a weapon skill first, and then activate two regular skills in order to create an explosive burst.
Well, that's done. Now I'll tell you more about Circle Shield. The Circle Shield reduces your opponent's AG. When your opponent hits you, your Circle Shield will be activated at a certain rate.
If their AG is reduced, they won't be able to use some of their skills, so you'll be at an advantage. Keep in mind that the Circle Shield can only be used when you equip a shield.
You will be blessed with the power of Rugard, and every time you level up, you will obtain more stat points. Congratulations!

The Dark Stone is an ancient treasure known to have been sacred to the Knight's tribe. Most records of the item have seemed to gone extinct, but information was learned that some of Kundun's minors may be using its power to their advantage! Not much information is necessarily known about the item, but it is known to have the ability to grant great strength and knowledge to its possessor. Although powerful, only descendants of the Knight's tribe will be able to understand and learn its ability.
Where to find the Dark Stone?
What monsters drops the Dark Stone?
Aida: Death Tree, Forest Orc, Death Rider, Blue Golem, Witch Queen, Hellmaine.

NPC Apostle Devin, in Crywolf, is searching for a mighty warrior to accept a very difficult quest. Ultimatly, he plans to infiltrate Balgass' Barracks and kill the evil war lord, Dark Elf, that lurks within! The Dark Elf is there, training soldiers to attack the contenient. This task will not be easy, and it may be the most difficult battle you've encountered yet! It is wise to form a Party to take on this difficult quest.
Quest of Sebina the Priest or Marlon [Completed]
The God of Light, Rugard, has delivered a new mission.
Rugard has told me to find heroes who will fight against the new threat in Balgass in his stead.
We assume that the Balgass Army attempting the Crywolf Fortress may bring new threats to the continent... But we still don't know the details.
We are doing our best to understand Rugard's request. But we are facing many difficulties due to our... inadequacy.
I believe you have the ability to help us out. Would you please lend us a hand?
In order to help us, you must fight the Balgass Army... Before you face their power, we need to confirm that you are strong enough.
Please defeat the Death Beam Knight, Hell Maine and Dark Phoenix in Tarkan, Aida and Icarus, and bring back 1 proof for each.
Congratulations. You have completed the mission. I'll give you a small reward for your hard work.
Kundun made a bargain with Ereshkigal, the Queen of Pandemonium, and summoned Balgass on earth. Its mere existence is a threat.
We are guessing that Balgass, who leads the Pandemonium Army, is bringing new threats to the continent.
Where to find the Death Beam Knight Flame?
Tarkan: You have to kill the monster Death Beam Knight, He spawn around the coordinates [160, 210].
Where to find the Dark Phoenix Feather?
Icarus: You have to kill the monster Phoenix of Darkness, He spawn around the coordinates [40, 220].
Where to find the Hell Miner Horn?
Aida: You have to kill the monster Hell Maine, He spawn around the coordinates [100, 160] and [110, 50].
NPC Werewolf Guardsman requires (x3,000,000) Zen as a fee, each time you enter Balgass' Barracks.
Welcome. You seem ready to help us now.
According to the information we've gathered, Balgass has created a special place called the {0}. We, the Twelve Disciples of Rugard, believe that {1} is our new threat.
To find out more information about the {0}, and to reduce the threat of the soldiers being trained by Balgass, we must infiltrate it.
Thanks to Rugard's protection, we recently found a way to get into {0}. Would you be willing to infiltrate the barracks, defeat the soldiers, and bring back more information about the place?
Go to the cemetery to the north of Crywolf, and you'll find a runaway soldier from Balgass Barracks. He was blessed with intelligence thanks to Rugard. He calls himself {0}.
He will take you there. Please identify the trainees at Balgass Barracks, and kill 20 of each kind.
You have completed the mission safely. I praise your amazing skills and strong will to fight even in the toughest of situations.
The information you brought back and the enemies you defeated will help bring peace to MU and Crywolf.
'Do you even know about me? I've been both blessed and cursed from Lugard. You may be helped if you are appropriately quialified'.
If you have passed through the Apostle Devin's test, Werewolf Guardsman will send you and your party members Balgass Barrack.
You must be located closely together in order to enter Balgass Barrack at once.
In order to receive help from Werewolf Guardsman; {0}.
Can I do the quest in party?
Your courage has shown us that there is hope.
It looks like Balgass is currently hiding somewhere, recovering from battle.
In order to carry out Rugard's mission, we must find out Balgass exact location and defeat the soldiers he's training.
This last trial to carry out Rugard's mission will be a lot tougher than anything you have faced so far. Will you accept the last trial?
Go inside the castle gate to the north of Balgass Barracks. We'll make the preparations so that you can enter.
Congratulations! You have passed Rugard's last trial. Rugard's protection will be with you from now on.
Thanks to your efforts, MU and Crywolf will be safe from Balgass threats for a while. I praise your skills.
'Hmm, who are you? I'm confused. Are you even approved of Balgass?'.
Rugard's 12 apostles are helping by blinding the gatekeeper by the road to Balgass Resting Place.
Apostle Devin's third mission request enables entrance into the resting place.
Can I do the quest in party?

NPC Sent is a female knight with a graceful figure. She is one of the 12 Priests of Light, a guardian knight serving the sacred god Lugard. Carrying out the duties as Rugard's Guardian Knight in many places, she now seeks heroic adventurers to test their ability and earn Rugard's blessing. She will pass down her knowledgable power and skill to those that can prove their worthiness.
I am the one of the 12 priests who serve Rugard. I was asked by priest Devin. To share my power with the hero who mastered the power of blessing. Is that the person you told Devin?

Yes, but my power can pollute myself, So you have to make sure that you are elegible to receive the power first. In this village where there are villagers, it is dangerous for you to test your strength. Are you okay?
You will be teleported to the "Area of eligibility"

This is a place of qualification that can only be entered by those who have mastered the power of blessing. You can take the test with a colleague you meet here. Of course, if you are confident, you can take the test on your own.
It is your last choice. Did you have a party with your colleague? Or will you be tested on your own? Moving to the test area or returning to town is your choice.
You may meet the conditions to take the test but I need to check if you are strong enough to use the power.
Firstly, try to win against me. Do not worry as I will be using only a portion of my power against you.
Sounds good. Please show your abilities in battle against me. Let's begin.
You have proved yourself in the first battle against me.
However, you are only prepared to be given the new power. It is now up to you to overcome any and all hardships during the test.
Can I do the quest in party?
Do you know? MU is no longer a safe place. Ferea has been discovered and Nixies are being reborn. Powerful monsters begin to appear across MU. You need to be prepared to deal with them.
Truth is, the deep dungeon is where I trained myself to become a guardian knight long ago. You will not be ready to face the upcoming battles unless you defeat the monsters here.

I am about to summon the monsters from the deep dungeon. Defeat 5 Deep Dungeon Skeleton Warriors, 5 Larva and 5 Cyclops. And you must survive for 5 minutes. I sincerely hope you survive and take the last test. Now, I will summon the monsters.
You did it. You survived against those terrible creatures from the deep dungeon.
You are now completely ready to take the last test.
Can I do the quest in party?
This is the last test I have for you.
Once again, fight against me and win. This time, you have to fight with me while defeating the monsters from the deep dungeon as well.
Have you gathered your friends? If you are ready, let us begin.
You have completed all the tests. And showed your ability. I believe you could become a Lugard's guardin knight who can stand beside me someday.
You have passed all the tests and you are now ready to use the new power. I praise your skills. Please use the Hotkey {0} to check out your new power.
Can I do the quest in party?
Eunice is the older sister of {0}, one of the 12 Priests of Light, and is a guardian knight who serves the good god Lugard.
Sent is good at swordsmanship, but Eunice is good at swordsmanship using the 'large scythe (war side)'.
One of the group of guardian knights dispatched to discover extra damage.
Currently, like Sent, he is on a mission to impart new power to the powerful warriors of the Mu continent.
Eunice has a friend who specializes in mechanical engineering, which is the most valuable thing on the Mu continent.
He also appears to be occasionally helping his friend with his research.
The space of qualification is an area where you prepare to proceed with the quest.
In the space of qualifications, you can form a party with colleagues who will perform quests together.
You can enter the space of qualification through NPC Eunice located at Devias Village.
Only characters above level 1,200 can enter.
You can enter the test space through NPC Eunice located in the qualification space.
When in a party state, when one of the party members applies to enter the test space, all party members will be moved to the test space.
You can proceed with the first quest through NPC Eunice located in the test space.
Eunice and the Burning Kethotum monster appear together.
When completing the first quest, the character is given the {0} buff.
If you defeat Eunice within the one minute time limit, the quest will be cleared.
After clearing the first quest, you can proceed with the second quest through NPC Eunice.
Eunice and the Burning Kethotum monster appear together.
When completing the 2nd quest, the character is given the {0} buff.
If you defeat Eunice within the one minute time limit, the quest will be cleared.
Extra Ability Card, 3 types (Nuke, Bolt, Wide area)
After clearing the 2nd quest, you can proceed with the 3rd quest through NPC Eunice.
Eunice and the Burning Kethotum monster appear together.
When completing the 3rd quest, the character is given an 'extra wide area damage' buff.
If you defeat Eunice within the one minute time limit, the quest will be cleared.
*By equipping the extra ability card to the 5th ability enhancement tree, you can use extra damage.
After you have completed the 5th class change, you can proceed with the exclusive mount quest through NPC Eunice.
When proceeding with the quest, {0} are initially required to create a giant mount.
After submitting the requested item to the NPC, the battle will proceed.
The quest will be completed if you defeat Eunice riding the Giant within the 1 minute time limit.
Upon clearing the quest, you will receive the Giant Mount (1 random among 3 types of Giants).

The elemental system is a system added in the ex700 season, which can make users get over the gap between high level users and low level users through opposite elements, this allows you to have elemental damage and elemental defense, applicable for {0} and {1}.
Elemental damage is displayed separately and in a different color, depending on the Element you are using.
The system works through a pentagram, which you can equip in a special slot.
There are a total of 5 elements
When a character not equipped with pentagram is attacked, the charater would be assorted as none element and receives 120% damage from players with other elements
In PVP, elemental damage is increased by 30%
How do you read the table of elements?
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has the fire element, the attacker's damage is 100%, that is, {0} damage.
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has the water element, the attacker's damage is 80%, that is, he will deal {0} damage than the opponent.
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has the earth element, the attacker's damage is 90%, that is, he will deal {0} damage than the opponent.
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has the wind element, the attacker's damage is 110%, that is, he will deal {0} damage than the opponent.
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has the darkness element, the attacker's damage is 120%, that is, he will deal {0} damage than the opponent.
If the attacker has the fire element and the defender has no element, the attacker's damage is 120%, that is, he will do {0} damage than the opponent.
Pentagrams are a very important item that provide elemental damage and defense to your character.
There are 2 types, normal pentagrams (begginer to unique) and mastery pentagrams.
Each pentagram can have from 1 to 5 slots to add errtels.
The {0} of the pentagram must be unlocked with the item EXPANSION SCROLL OF RADIANCE SLOT
When you create the character you will get the beginner pentagram that you can place in its special slot.
Slot of Anger: Equipped with Errtel of Anger
Slot of Blessing: Equipped with Errtel of Blessing
Slot of Integrity: Equipped with Errtel of Integrity
Slot of Divinity: Equipped with Errtel of Divinity
Slot of Radiance: Equipped with Errtel of Radiance
Weaker Element: Our element is much weaker than this element.
Weak Element: Our element is weaker than this element.
Neutral Element: Our element is neutral against the same element.
Strong Element: Our element is stronger than this element.
Stronger Element: Our element is much stronger than this element.
Normal: Acheron (Ubaid, Alkamar, Debenter, Uruk Mountain and Nars)
Rare: Acheron (Debenter, Uruk Mountain and Nars)
Unique: Boss Monster (Lord of Ferea, Lord Silvester, Core Magriffy)
Drop can be from 1~4 slots or 2~4 slots
Pentagram have a Trade Limit which limits the amount of times it can be traded. You can increase the trade limit by using {0} item on it.
Trade Limit can be increased via Transaction Seal by one increment.
Transaction Seal is purchased from the Cash Item Shop.
Transaction Seal can be traded, sold in Personal Store and stored in Vault.
All pentagrams can increase Trade Limit up to 255 max.
An item's Trade Limit decreases when it is traded or sold between two character.
An item's Trade Limit does not decrease when it is stored in Vault.
Pentagrams have a Trade Limit of 1 when dropped by monsters.
The errtels are the items that the pentagrams is composed.
There are 5 types of errtels and each type has 5 different elements.
Each errtel can have {0} (in the future, maybe it will be 5) and each rank can have {1}.
You can insert errtel of any elemental type into pentagram.
When errtel is inserted into a pentagram item, it will add the additional options listed on the errtel item to the pentagram.
To acquire errtels you have to create them at the NPC ADNIEL, using Mithril, Jewel of Bless and Zen.
To get {0} you need to get {1}.
Mithril Fragments are obtained from the drop of any elemental monster.
When you get 5 Mithril Fragments, it will automatically be converted to Mithril in your inventory.
To create errtels you have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
There is a 50% chance of success.
If the result is successful you will get a random errtel of the same element as the Mithril used.
If the result is not successful, you will lose the items.
How to level up an errtel?
To level up an errtel you have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
If the result is successful you will have raised the rank of the errtel 1 level.
If the result is not successful, the errtel can be destroyed.
Elemental Rune is needed to level up the Errtel.
The Elemental Rune can be acquired from the NPC of each town.
When you upgrade a Pentagram item or Errtel, your chance for successful upgrade increases by 10%
Use this after putting it into the combination window
A combination Talisman that prevents items from disappearing when upgrading Pentagram or Errtel items
Use this after putting it into the combination window
How to rank up an errtel?
To rank up an errtel you have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
There is a 100% chance of success.
In the main slot insert the errtel you want to keep, a random option will be added.
In the secondary slot insert the errtel that will disappear.
2 equal errtels, Errtel Rank 1, Level +7 (same type and element)
2 equal errtels, Errtel Rank 2, Level +7 (same type and element)
How to unlock errtel radiance slot?
To unlock the errtel radiance slot, you need the {0} item.
You have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
There is a 100% chance of success.
Result: Expansion Scroll of Radiance slot
How to get Fragments Of Radiance Slot?
You can get Fragments Of Radiance Slot by opening elemental capsules.
You can get elemental capsules by disassembling errtels.
Each errtel will give you 1 Elemental Powder.
If you collect 50 Elemental Powder you will receive 1 Elemental Capsule.
There are 2 Mastery Pentagrams, Brilliant Orb (I) and Antonias' Sword (I).
Unique pentagrams of +11 level or higher can be upgraded to Mastery Pentagrams.
Mastery Pentagrams add 4 new Attribute option slots.
Mastery Pentagrams can only use Mastery Errtels, with the exception of the Radiance errtel.
You can acquire {0} / {1} according Unique general pentagrams.
To upgrade pentagrams you need to go to NPC Adniel
What are the pentagrams that can be upgraded to mastery?
Unique pentagrams +11 or higher can be upgraded to mastery pentagrams.
If the number of socket slots is insufficient, upgrade may not be possible.
How to create a Mastery Pentagram?
To create a mastery pentagram, you need an {0} Pentagram.
You have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
Where to get the pentagram emblem?
To get the pentagram emblem you must buy it with Ruud.
You have to go to Elbeland and find the NPC Priest James.
How to create the Attribute option?

blocks.alt: How To Create the Attribute Option

text.t: To create the Attribute option, you need a Mastery Pentagram.
You have to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
The Mastery Errtel will disappear after the creation of the attribute option
Errtel of Anger Attack Against {0} Element
Errtel of Blessing Defense Against {0} Element
Errtel of Integrity Attack Against {0} Element
Errtel of Divinity Defense Against {0} Element
If you use an {0} to create the elemental option, you will get the {1} option.
The Elemental Option cannot duplicate a similar option that has the Pentagram in its Relative Options.
You cannot add 2 attack options against the same element, for example, you cannot add 2 attack options against wind.
You cannot add 2 defense options against the same element, for example, you cannot add 2 defense options against fire.
You can add 1 Attack option against wind and 1 Defense option against wind.
How to level up the Pentagram Attribute option

blocks.alt: How To Level Up the Attribute Option

text.t: To level up the Attribute option, you need to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
If the result is failed, the option does not disappear, the level will decrease by 1
How to remove the Pentagram Attribute option?

blocks.alt: How To Remove the Attribute Option

text.t: To remove the Attribute option, you need to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
if you remove the attribute option you will not recover the errtel used, it will just remove the option.
Normal errtels can be upgraded to Mastery Errtels.
There are 2 types of Mastery Errtels, Passion and Determination.
Mastery Errtels remove ranks and become normal, rare, or unique, based on their previous rank.
All Mastery Errtels can be upgraded except for {0}, it cannot be upgraded.
The normal {0} can be used in a Mastery Pentagram.
To upgrade errtels you need to go to NPC Adniel
How to upgrade an Errtel to Mastery Errtel?
Errtel upgrade success chance increases based on Errtel level.
When upgrading, all options from Errtel Normal are inherited.
To upgrade an errtel to mastery errtel, you need to go to Elbeland or Acheron and find the NPC ADNIEL.
If your normal errtel is {0}, you can't upgrade it.
If your normal errtel is {0}, an 80% success rate applies.
If your normal errtel is {0} and {1}, an 95% success rate applies.

The Guardian System was added to Mu Online in Season 14. These are mounts that players can obtain, craft, and upgrade for benefits such as improved defense and attack (normal and elemental) and resistance options against elite monsters.
To obtain the items necessary for the first Guardian you must go to the NPC Moss located in Elbeland.
- Guardian items can be used over level 800.
- It cannot be used simultaneously with other pets such as Uniria, Dinorant or Fenrir, however, it can be used simultaneously with Dark Spirit.
- Guardians are inventory-mounted items that can be accessed by 'right-clicking' in the inventory.
- Guardians have normal and elite resistance options, and the option effect is activated when worn.
Creation and upgrade of Guardian items
- Guardians can be created and upgraded through the Lorencia Trainer NPC.
- It can be enhanced up to level +15, and the stats of the options increase according to the enhancement level.
- Guardians health decreases according to the wearing time.
- When HP reaches 0, the wearer is removed and options are not applied.
- Health can be recovered through the {0} item and upon recovery is restored to 100%.
* Guardians are not affected by Master Skill Tree {0}.
Guardian items can have 1 to 3 General Options depending on probability.

This is a system where you can dig Jewel of Bless in a mining area using a Pandora pick.
The pick has a durability that is consumed when mining in the mining area.
To get Pandora's Pick, you need to go to Karutan, talk to NPC {0}, and buy Pandora's Pick.
When you buy the Pandora Pick it has a durability of 1/255.
For every time you attempt to mine, the Pandora's Pick durability will decrease.
Pandora's Pick durability decrease will depend on the type of mining area you mine.
Blue Mining Area: Decreases durability by 2.
Purple Mining Area: Decreases durability by 4.
Gold Mining Area: Decreases durability by 8.
REPAIR: To repair Pandora's Pick, you must use Jewel of Bless.
For each Jewel of Bless you add to Pandora's Pick, its durability will increase by 4.
Pandora's Pickaxe is a two-handed item, and when equipped, the mining area is displayed in the safety zone of each designated area.
The areas authorized for mining are:
There are a total of 3 types of mining zones on each map, and the durability of the Pandora's Pick is different for each type.
Each type of mining area is divided into 5 levels and has a maximum amount of Jewel of Bless that you can get.
First of all, you need to buy Pandora Pick (two handed) and add Jewel of Bless to it to increase its durability to be able to use it.
Move to a safe area of the maps available for mining and approach one of the mining areas you want to try your luck. (You must have the Pandora Pick equipped).
Left click on a mining area and it will start mining (will decrease the durability of Pandora's Pick depending on the type of mining area).
If you've been lucky and your attempt is successful, the amount of jewels you've found will appear above the mining area.
You can collect those jewels or try your luck again and go to the next level.
If you decide to keep trying your luck and fail, you will lose the accumulated jewels.
If you decide to collect the jewels, move the character to another coordinate and a message will appear for you to decide.
If you complete all the levels of the mining area, there is a small chance that you will get Pandora's Gift, a huge amount of Jewel of Bless.
If you log out of the game before you can claim the mined Jewel of Bless, you will lose all the Jewel of Bless that were mined.

Four evil's cursed wings were created by great wizards in Arca, the city of wizards and it was told that those wing were made of parts from killed monsters.
A wizard related to the creation of wing said that those wing were cursed by the evil spirits of killed monsters.
The force of Kundun got to know the secret through a correspondence in Arca and start to misuse the wings.
Therefore, Wizards researched for many years to seal the wings and finally they did. Since the wizards sealed the wings, no one has seen them in the continent of MU...
By words, when normal human equips the evil's cursed wings, the human will be influenced by evil's power and he will be several times stronger.
Meanwhile, wizards who were controlled by evils escaped from Arca to study the evil's cursed wing and they eventually created materials to reinforce the wings.
These materials can't normally be discovered in the continent of MU, but only traded between evils in secret.
